definitions.explanation: A piece of writing in a newspaper, magazine, or website.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧{記事|きじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{記事|きじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧。

notes:
{記事|きじ} refers to an article or written piece in newspapers, magazines, or online media.

COMMON TYPES:
- {新聞|しんぶん}{記事|きじ}: newspaper article
- ニュース{記事|きじ}: news article
- {特集|とくしゅう}{記事|きじ}: feature article
- ブログ{記事|きじ}: blog post/article
- {関連|かんれん}{記事|きじ}: related article

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {記事|きじ}を{書|か}く: to write an article
- {記事|きじ}を{読|よ}む: to read an article
- {記事|きじ}を{載|の}せる: to publish an article
- {記事|きじ}になる: to become news

RELATED WORDS:
- {記者|きしゃ}: journalist, reporter
- {報道|ほうどう}: news reporting
- コラム: column (opinion piece)
